Using a simple red-light/green-light system, we flag risks and provide insights you can filter by importance or section. Fast, efficient, and built for business. Identify risks, refine language, and export a new proposed version to the other side, all with confidence. Whether you're a startup or an enterprise, if your non-lawyer teams are reviewing contracts manually, you're slowing down deals. goHeather uses advanced legal AI to review and edit agreements so your business can save money and move faster. Examples of actual, informative insights from our lawyer-trained contract review AIRisk Level: HighQuote from contact"The Employee's first three months are probationary. During this probationary period, the Employee's employment may be terminated without notice."AI InsightThis is a probationary period, which is legal under British Columbia employment standards for three months only. Under the common law, however, employees could be entitled to notice of termination even if they are terminated before three months has expired. Consider removing this clause and defaulting to the common law.Risk Level: HighQuote from contact"The Employee agrees that the Employer has the right to change the Employee's job title, position, duties and/or place of employment in the same city, with notice, without any such change constituting a breach of this Agreement, a constructive dismissal, or a change in the rights and obligations of the parties under this Agreement."AI InsightThis clause gives the employer a lot of discretion to change the terms of employment.
